searchText: I'm concerned for newcomers who don't have a stable test environment to try before mainnet. Exit queue is too long on Medalla and many people are switching off now. <@!710066339045179464> v1.0 testnets are in progress eth2 call thursday https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-pm/issues/191 5 validators added in the past 7 hours, a little concerning no? https://etherscan.io/txs?a=0x00000000219ab540356cbb839cbe05303d7705fa&p=1 <@!772454146766536719> depends, has every client released a mainnet ready version? If not, I'd suspect those who participated in the testnets are awaiting an official release from their respective client before depositing
